fields.statement: Verifier claude-code-e4cda6c3 at 468bae82 ran go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api -run 'TestWatchdog(GreenUnmerged|ReadPR|CIRerun|PRNoCI)' with the fake gh: TestWatchdogCIRerun, TestWatchdogPRNoCI, TestWatchdogGreenUnmerged, TestWatchdogGreenUnmergedReadsOnce, TestWatchdogReadPR and TestWatchdogGreenUnmergedSkipsBusyChange all PASS; go vet and gofmt clean. Read the diff: watchdogReadPR returns an empty head unless readShipState names st.ID as Run (no record or Run empty gives every run no PR; PLAN gets none while SHIP owns it), and all three passes (green-unmerged, CI-rerun, no-CI) skip an empty head, so a succeeded plan run gets no hold, resume or merge (the 0568a71 case); watchdogReadOnce caches by run ID, so the owner's read does not leak to the plan run; watchdogGreenUnmerged also skips a change set any of whose runs is live or has a continue queued (tested both ways), while an idle succeeded run still gets its hold and the existing owner-run hold/resume tests still pass.
